scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Validate the finite input and output grain
cases.input_contract: Read a static copy of the two-row schema fixture and require bigint id/cents, known nonnull values and at most 8 rows. Return its canonical ordered bag without removing duplicates.
cases.expected: The first bag is 1:100,2:200. A NULL identity or cents value is rejected.
cases.verification: Compare the exact two-row bag and reject an explicit null-id DataFrame.

cases.title: Run the first finite file stream
cases.input_contract: Execute the AvailableNow Parquet query with its owned checkpoint/output and retain query ID, run ID, input count and batch IDs.
cases.expected: Two input rows and exactly 1:100,2:200 in the committed sink.
cases.verification: Assert the progress input count is 2, query is terminated, and readback bag is exact.

cases.title: Resume the same checkpoint after a new file
cases.input_contract: Publish a second file with 2:200 and 3:300, then restart the compatible query with the same checkpoint and sink.
cases.expected: Only 2 new input rows are processed. The sink bag is 1:100,2:200,2:200,3:300. Query ID persists and run ID changes.
cases.verification: Compare both identities, progress count and all 4 output occurrences.

cases.title: Resume with no new source files
cases.input_contract: Run the same compatible query again without adding input and compare output before/after.
cases.expected: Zero new input rows and an unchanged 4-row output bag.
cases.verification: Assert zero progress input sum and exact unchanged sink rows.

cases.title: Replay with a separate checkpoint and output
cases.input_contract: Start from a new checkpoint only when the output namespace is also new. Replay the same source and preserve the old checkpoint/sink.
cases.expected: The separate output has 4 rows, with a new logical query ID. The old output remains 4 rows.
cases.verification: Assert checkpoint/output paths differ and both independent bags equal the literal 4-row oracle.

cases.title: Write a guarantee ledger from exact counts
cases.input_contract: Return output row count, distinct business IDs and total cents, then explain why source recovery is not business-ID deduplication or a universal exactly-once guarantee.
cases.verification: Compare all three independent values and preserve the duplicate occurrence.
